positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:

positions.title: Advanced Technology Engineer, R&D
positions.description:
- Camera video encryption using Verimatrix Conditional Access System (CAS) for digital rights management (DRM), FFMPEG to transcode/transmux for IPTV/OTT playback
- Anti-privacy, threats analysis, clone detection, videomark

positions.title: SR STAFF ENGINEER
positions.description:
TV Group
•	Android Google TV natural input (face detection, hand gesture, voice) software development
